status_note: Phase R amended and closed 2026-09-04 (docs/decisions/2026-09-04-phase-r-scope-amendment.md): Phase R now gates operational restoration (routing, security, Breakglass, Build, Explore, Compaction, Reviewer OPERATIONAL integration), not per-role model-quality optimization. Reviewer's 5/5 seeded-defect + clean-zero benchmark is reclassified to a Phase-3 quality evaluation -- unchanged threshold, unchanged fixture/scorer, historical runs still inadmissible for quality adjudication -- and is no longer a Phase-R gate. Reviewer's operational integration (model resolves, correct routing, read-only permissions, successful dispatch through the real OpenCode path, output traversing the evaluation/adapter path, no security regression) is fully evidenced by existing repository records; see the amendment doc's evidence table. This is a separation-of-concerns correction, not a threshold relaxation. Production routing is unchanged -- it was already installed and active on the real, user-global OpenCode configuration since Task 16 of the original Phase-R execution. 'canonical_quality_reference' here means restoration-quality reference, not a claim that every role's model is the optimal choice for its role; that remains a separate, ongoing, hypothesis-driven Phase-3 concern.
provenance_ceiling: Ordinary sessions are attributable only to the profile known to be installed at the time.
